HANGZHOU, Sept. 30 (Xinhua) -- China's Xie Zhenye clinched the Men's 100m gold at Hangzhou Asian Games here on Saturday.
Boonson Puripol of Thailand took the silver in 10.02, while Muhammad Azeem Bin Mohd Fahmi of Malaysia rounded out the podium in 10.11.
